verdict.rationale: The GitHub README and runtime probes show a single `npx skills add owner/repo` command installs a skill keylessly and near-instantly, with `--list` letting devs preview skills before installing — consistent with a sub-five-minute path from nothing to installed skill. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party quickstart doc stating an expected time-to-first-skill, and independent (non-vendor) hands-on timing confirmation.
